name: T4P Dashboard Notes
author: sebastiantrainers4professionals

sections.description:
T4P Dashboard Notes lets you create beautiful, formatted notes directly on your WordPress dashboard.

Ideal for:
– Quick reminders for yourself or your team
– Instructions for editors or clients
– Internal documentation and workflow notes
– Onboarding checklists
– Sticky notes for tasks, ideas, and drafts

✨ Features

  • Add unlimited dashboard notes
  • Colored note backgrounds for visual organization
  • Rich text editor with headings, lists, links, bold/italic formatting
  • Custom note titles
  • Drag & drop positioning of widgets
  • Fast “Add Note” button directly on the dashboard
  • Edit, View, and Delete actions directly on the note
  • Lightweight & clean – no unnecessary scripts or settings

Perfect for agencies, site managers, editors, and anyone who wants to keep important information visible on the dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/t4p-dashboard-notes/, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to your Dashboard and click “Add Note”.
  4. Edit the title, add text, choose a background color, and save.
sections.faq:
Can I show notes only to administrators?

Yes. Dashboard notes appear only for logged-in users with access to the dashboard (typically Editors, Admins, or custom roles depending on your site).

Can I export or back up notes?

Yes. Notes are saved as custom post types and included in normal site backups.

Will this slow down my dashboard?

No. The plugin is lightweight, loads only on the dashboard, and adds no external scripts.

Can I customize the colors further?

More customization features are planned for upcoming releases.
